name: Static Jolt
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level magus 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature or object touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Your hand surges with a powerful static shock.

You must succeed on a melee touch attack to deliver this jolt, which deals 1d4 points of electricity damage.
